description: This file implements an admission controller for Kubernetes that enforces the image pull policy to 'Always' for all Pods, ensuring private images are always pulled with valid credentials. It includes registration, admission, validation, and utility functions related to this policy.

classes.name: AlwaysPullImages
classes.description: A struct implementing admission.Interface that enforces 'Always' image pull policy on Pods.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Modifies Pod objects to set image pull policy to 'Always' during admission.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates that all containers and volumes in the Pod have 'Always' image pull policy.

methods.name: isUpdateWithNoNewImages
methods.description: Checks if the admission operation is an update that does not introduce new images.

methods.name: shouldIgnore
methods.description: Determines if the admission request should be ignored based on resource type and operation.

methods.name: NewAlwaysPullImages
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the admission handler for enforcing 'Always' image pull policy.
